```yaml
name: Check Release
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install just
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y just

      - name: Check release version
        run: |
          # Get current version from Cargo.toml
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep "^version" Cargo.toml | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f2)
          
          # Get latest tag
          LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0.0")
          
          # Extract version from tag
          TAG_VERSION=${LATEST_TAG#v}
          
          # Compare versions
          if [[ "$CURRENT_VERSION" == "$TAG_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Version matches tag"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if version is incremented
          if [[ "$(echo -e "$TAG_VERSION\n$CURRENT_VERSION" | sort -V | head -n1)" == "$TAG_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Version is properly incremented"
          else
            echo "Version not incremented correctly"
            exit 1
          fi
```
